children: Zamanat Fund CEIC Limited, a DFSA-regulated credit fund domiciled in the DIFC and managed by Truleum Venture Partners, launches with its fund interests issued as ZM1 Investment Tokens on ZIGChain. ZIG Markets is named Distribution Agent for Professional Clients, and the fund targets up to $100M, making it the chain's first live regulated fund issuance.

Tokenizing fund interests on ZIGChain gives the network a regulated real-world asset use case rather than a conceptual one. Because the fund operates under DFSA oversight and distributes through ZIG Markets to Professional Clients, the issuance ties chain activity to a compliance framework that institutional participants can evaluate. If the structure works as designed, it could support incremental adoption of the network by showing that regulated fund administration can run on ZIGChain infrastructure.
Across the GCC, SMEs face a $250 billion financing gap, with only 11% having access to credit. In the UAE, they generate more than half of GDP yet receive less than 10% of total bank lending.
